definition-changed.answer: The rule speaks of a declarative (USE) procedure, which is a declarative section in both editions; §2002:4 (entry 4.150) already covers one section ('one or more successive ... sections'), and §2023:3.145 only spells out the single paragraph/section case. Same units, scope unchanged.

pending-clause.answer: Read §2002:14.5.12.1.1 through §2002:14.5.12.2 against §2023:14.6.13.1.1 through §2023:14.6.13.2. The 2002 differences are: no MERGE/SORT, fatal-EC-I-O or PERFORM WHEN steps in fatal processing (§2023:14.6.13.1.3 (items 2-4) are 2023-only), the 2002 non-fatal wording, and the incompatible-data text. GR3's second sentence rests on RESUME NEXT STATEMENT (§2002:14.8.31.3 GR2, the same in 2023) and on the declarative running for a fatal condition (2002 item 2, the same as 2023 item 5). An INITIALIZE is none of the 2023-only cases. The witness pb419_initialize_resume_boundary (accept [2002], EC-BOUND-SUBSCRIPT, Fatal in the 2002 table) runs that exact path at 2002 and MATCHes.
